res.status(201).json({ success: true, event: logEvent });\n      } catch (err) {\n        console.error('Error processing POST /api/events:', err);\n        res.status(500).json({ error: 'Internal (req: Request, res: Response) => {\n      try {\n        const eventsArray = req.body;\n\n        // Validate request body is an array\n        if (!Array.isArray(eventsArray)) {\n          res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid request body', message: 'Expected JSON array of events' });\n          return;\n        }\n\n        // Check batch size limit\n        if (eventsArray.length spanEvents.filter((e) => e.trace_id === traceId)\n          : spanEvents;\n\n        // Build span nodes and index\n        const spanMap = new Map<string, SpanNode>();\n        const rootSpans: SpanNode[] = [];\n        const traceCounts = new Map<string, number>();\n\n        for (const event of filteredEvents) {\n          const spanId = event.span_id as string;\n          const traceId = event.trace_id as string;\n\n          // Count spans per trace\n          traceCounts.set(traceId, (traceCounts.get(traceId) || 0) + 1);\n\n          // Create span node if not exists\n          if (!spanMap.has(spanId)) {\n            const node: SpanNode = {\n              span_id: spanId,\n              trace_id: traceId,\n              parent_span_id: event.parent_span_id as string | null || null,\n              name: event.span_name as string || event.msg || 'Unknown',\n              worker_id: event.worker,\n              bead_id: event.bead || null,\n              start_ts: event.start_ts ? Number(event.start_ts) : null,\n              end_ts: event.end_ts ? Number(event.end_ts) : null,\n              duration_ms: event.duration_ms || null,\n              status: event.level === 'error' ? 'error' : 'ok',\n              attributes: {},\n              children: [],\n            };\n            spanMap.set(spanId, node);\n          }\n        }\n\n        // Build tree structure by linking children to parents\n        for (const [spanId, node] of spanMap) {\n          if (node.parent_span_id && spanMap.has(node.parent_span_id)) {\n            // Add as child to parent\n            spanMap.get(node.parent_span_id)!.children.push(node);\n          } else if (!node.parent_span_id) {\n            // Root span (no parent)\n            rootSpans.push(node);\n          }\n        }\n\n        // Build traces array\n        const traces = Array.from(traceCounts.entries()).map(([trace_id, span_count]) => ({\n          trace_id,\n          span_count,\n        }));\n\n        const response: SpanDagResponse = {\n          roots: rootSpans,\n          totalSpans: spanMap.size,\n          traces,\n        };\n\n        res.json(response);\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error fetching span DAG:', error);\n        res.status(500).json({\n          error: 'Failed to fetch span DAG',\n          message: error instanceof Error ? createWebPresetManager, FocusPreset } from './utils/focusPresets';\n\nconst FOCUS_MODE_STORAGE_KEY = 'fabric-focus-mode';\n\n// WebSocket reconnection configuration\nconst RECONNECT_BASE_DELAY = 1000; // 1 second\nconst RECONNECT_MAX_DELAY = 30000; // 30 seconds\nconst RECONNECT_MAX_RETRIES = 10;  // Max retries before manual intervention\n\n// Focus preset manager singleton\nlet presetManagerInstance: FocusPresetManager | null = null;\n\nfunction getPresetManager(): FocusPresetManager {\n  if (!presetManagerInstance) {\n    presetManagerInstance = createWebPresetManager();\n  }\n  return presetManagerInstance;\n}\n\n// Connection states\ntype ConnectionState = 'connected' | 'reconnecting' | 'disconnected';\n\ninterface ReconnectState {\n  state: ConnectionState;\n  attemptCount: number;\n  nextRetryIn: number | null;\n}\n\n/**\n * Custom hook for WebSocket with auto-reconnect and exponential backoff\n */\nfunction useWebSocketReconnect(\n  onMessage: (message: WebSocketMessage) => void\n): {\n  reconnectState: ReconnectState;\n  connect: () => void;\n  disconnect: () => void;\n  resetAndReconnect: () => void;\n} {\n  const wsRef = useRef<WebSocket | null>(null);\n  const reconnectTimeoutRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);\n  const countdownIntervalRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null);\n  const attemptCountRef = useRef(0);\n\n  const [reconnectState, setReconnectState] = useState<ReconnectState>({\n    state: 'disconnected',\n    attemptCount: 0,\n    nextRetryIn: null,\n  });\n\n  const getReconnectDelay = useCallback((attempt: number): number => {\n    // Exponential backoff: 1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, 16s, 30s (max)\n    const delay = Math.min(RECONNECT_BASE_DELAY * Math.pow(2, attempt), RECONNECT_MAX_DELAY);\n    return delay;\n  }, []);\n\n  const clearTimers = useCallback(() => {\n    if (reconnectTimeoutRef.current) {\n      clearTimeout(reconnectTimeoutRef.current);\n      reconnectTimeoutRef.current = null;\n    }\n    if (countdownIntervalRef.current) {\n      clearInterval(countdownIntervalRef.current);\n      countdownIntervalRef.current = null;\n    }\n  }, []);\n\n  const scheduleReconnect = useCallback(() => {\n    clearTimers();\n\n    if (attemptCountRef.current >= RECONNECT_MAX_RETRIES) {\n      // Max retries reached - require manual intervention\n      setReconnectState({\n        state: 'disconnected',\n        attemptCount: attemptCountRef.current,\n        nextRetryIn: null,\n      });\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const delay = getReconnectDelay(attemptCountRef.current);\n    const targetTime = Date.now() + delay;\n\n    setReconnectState(prev => ({\n      ...prev,\n      state: 'reconnecting',\n      attemptCount: attemptCountRef.current,\n      nextRetryIn: Math.ceil(delay / 1000),\n    }));\n\n    // Countdown interval\n    countdownIntervalRef.current = setInterval(() => {\n      const remaining = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((targetTime - Date.now()) / 1000));\n      setReconnectState(prev => ({\n        ...prev,\n        nextRetryIn: remaining,\n      }));\n    }, 1000);\n\n    // Schedule reconnect\n    reconnectTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {\n      attemptCountRef.current++;\n      connectInternal();\n    }, delay);\n  }, [getReconnectDelay, clearTimers]);\n\n  const connectInternal = useCallback(() => {\n    clearTimers();\n\n    // Close existing connection if any\n    if (wsRef.current) {\n      wsRef.current.close();\n      wsRef.current = null;\n    }\n\n    const wsUrl = `${window.location.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss:' : 'ws:'}//${window.location.host}/ws`;\n    const ws = new WebSocket(wsUrl);\n    wsRef.current = ws;\n\n    ws.onopen = () => {\n      attemptCountRef.current = 0;\n      setReconnectState({\n        state: 'connected',\n        attemptCount: 0,\n        nextRetryIn: null,\n      });\n      console.log('WebSocket connected');\n    };\n\n    ws.onclose = (event) => {\n      console.log('WebSocket disconnected', event.code, event.reason);\n      // Only attempt reconnect if not manually closed (1000 = normal closure)\n      if (event.code !== 1000) {\n        scheduleReconnect();\n      } else {\n        setReconnectState({\n          state: 'disconnected',\n          attemptCount: attemptCountRef.current,\n          nextRetryIn: null,\n        });\n      }\n    };\n\n    ws.onerror = (err) => {\n      console.error('WebSocket error:', err);\n    };\n\n    ws.onmessage = (event) => {\n      try {\n        const message = JSON.parse(event.data) as WebSocketMessage;\n        onMessage(message);\n      } catch (err) {\n        console.error('Failed to parse message:', err);\n      }\n    };\n  }, [onMessage, clearTimers, scheduleReconnect]);\n\n  const connect = useCallback(() => {\n    connectInternal();\n  }, [connectInternal]);\n\n  const disconnect = useCallback(() => {\n    clearTimers();\n    if (wsRef.current) {\n      wsRef.current.close(1000, 'Manual disconnect');\n      wsRef.current = null;\n    }\n    setReconnectState({\n      state: 'disconnected',\n      attemptCount: 0,\n      nextRetryIn: null,\n    });\n  }, [clearTimers]);\n\n  const resetAndReconnect = useCallback(() => {\n    clearTimers();\n    attemptCountRef.current = 0;\n    connectInternal();\n  }, [clearTimers, connectInternal]);\n\n  // Auto-connect on mount\n  useEffect(() => {\n    connectInternal();\n    return () => {\n      disconnect();\n    };\n  }, [connectInternal, disconnect]);\n\n  return { reconnectState, connect, disconnect, resetAndReconnect };\n}\n\ninterface FocusModeState {\n  enabled: boolean;\n  pinnedWorkers: string[];\n  pinnedBeads: string[];\n}\n\n/**\n * Theme toggle button component\n */\nconst '☀️' : '🌙'}</span>\n      <span className=\"theme-toggle-label\">{theme === 'dark' ? ...w,\n            lastSeen: event.timestamp ??
